title: ticfac watch still replays earlier incarnations' terminal events
body: The from-now cursor fixed `events --follow`, but `ticfac watch` calls runfeed.Follow at offset zero: a watch started on a resumed run reads the previous incarnation's run_finished first, exits immediately, and reports a failure that already happened — the exact defect tick 55i describes for the feed's subscribers, in the command built to be alerted by it. Same fix shape (FollowFrom at End) plus its run_held semantics need thought, so it is a tick rather than a drive-by.
